items.title: Uber president Jill Hazelbaker joins OpenAI as communications chief
items.summary: Investing.com -- Uber Technologies Inc. announced Tuesday that President Jill Hazelbaker will leave the ride-hailing company to become chief corporate affairs officer at OpenAI, where she will oversee global communications and corporate positioning efforts.

items.title: Apple fails to impress Wall Street, bear market chatter heats up, and AI assessing job productivity
items.summary: Market Hang's panel discusses Apple's (AAPL) stock and how memory prices are affecting the company's bottom line.  Plus, how the midterms factor into a bear market outlook, and whether AI is doing "dirty work" at the office and assessing job productivity. Today's panel includes Tema ETFs Chief Investment Strategist Paisley Nardini, Aptus Capital Advisors Head of Equity & Portfolio Manager David Wagner, Business Insider Today Executive Editor & Anchor Dan DeFrancesco, Barron’s Tech Reporter Nate Wolf, and Wall Street Veteran & “The Buy Side” Author Turney Duff.
